mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_sn, o.coupon_id, o.integration, o.member_id, ot.id ot_id, ot.product_name ot_product_name, ot.product_sku_id ot_product_sku_id, ot.product_sku_code ot_product_sku_code, ot.product_quantity ot_product_quantity FROM oms_order o LEFT JOIN oms_order_item ot ON o.id = ot.order_id WHERE o.id = #{orderId}

SELECT o.id, o.order_sn, o.coupon_id, o.integration, o.member_id, o.use_integration, ot.id ot_id, ot.product_name ot_product_name, ot.product_sku_id ot_product_sku_id, ot.product_sku_code ot_product_sku_code, ot.product_quantity ot_product_quantity FROM oms_order o LEFT JOIN oms_order_item ot ON o.id = ot.order_id WHERE o.status = 0 AND o.create_time < date_add(NOW(), INTERVAL -#{minute} MINUTE);

UPDATE pms_sku_stock SET stock = CASE id
WHEN #{item.productSkuId} THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(stock,0) - #{item.productQuantity},0)
END, lock_stock = CASE id
WHEN #{item.productSkuId} THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(lock_stock,0) - #{item.productQuantity},0)
END WHERE id IN
#{item.productSkuId}

END WHERE id IN
